summary: Iteration 7: validated Loss-Making SKUs feature end-to-end + regression of prior pages. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass (8 loss-makers-specific + 9 regression). Frontend Playwright: sidebar 'nav-loss-makers' present, routes to /loss-makers, summary card shows '-€332.96 across 63 SKU × marketplace combos · 736 units sold at a loss', table renders 63 rows sorted by total_loss ascending (most negative first), marketplace chip click fires XHR with marketplaces=Amazon+Vendor param, EN/FR toggle switches label between 'Loss Makers' and 'Pertes'. All other pages (Dashboard, Products, Prices, Library, Profit & Loss, Heat Map, Orders, Customers, Uploads, Settings) load with zero console errors. No bugs found.

minor.issue: Endpoint also returns extra useful fields not listed in the spec (orders, revenue_eur) which is fine — spec keys all present. Additional guardrail: rows are skipped if production_cost == 0 (server.py:1575), so SKUs with no cost data are silently excluded — this is documented in the UI but may hide true loss makers if cost ingestion is incomplete.

action_items: (Carry-over from iter 6, not a Loss-Makers issue) Add admin-role check on POST /api/uploads/asin-mapping, /api/uploads/orders, /api/uploads/costs, PUT /api/cost-constants.
(Carry-over) server.py is now 1,772 lines — overdue for split into routers/.
critical_code_review_comments: loss_makers endpoint (server.py:1529-1595) is clean: single aggregation pipeline, per-SKU/marketplace grouping, correct math: total_cost = production + operational + production_shipping[mk] + avg_price * commission[mk]/100. Sort by total_loss_eur ascending is correct (most negative first).
Guard `if net_per_unit < 0 and prod_cost > 0` correctly filters loss-makers AND avoids false positives from SKUs with no cost-catalog entry (would otherwise show every $0-cost SKU as a 'loss').
build_match() reused from existing dashboard endpoints — date_from/date_to/marketplaces filters work identically; verified single-marketplace filter returns only rows for that marketplace.
Math consistency verified within ±€0.05 rounding on first 10 rows: total_cost ≈ prod+op+ship+comm, net ≈ avg_price - total_cost, total_loss ≈ net * units.
Frontend page (LossMakers.jsx) correctly passes marketplaces param when chip clicked — XHR `?date_from=...&marketplaces=Amazon+Vendor` observed.

Sidebar data-testids are complete and consistent: nav-dashboard, nav-marketplaces, nav-products, nav-prices, nav-library, nav-loss-makers, nav-customers, nav-profit-loss, nav-orders, nav-heatmap, nav-uploads, nav-settings.
i18n keys (nav.loss_makers) wired correctly — verified 'Loss Makers' ↔ 'Pertes' switch via lang-en/lang-fr toggle.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (loss-makers nav, route, summary card, table, marketplace filter, EN/FR toggle, plus 7-page regression all green)
